name: FlightDeck Accelerated Excel and Mathematics MVP - v2 (re-baselined 11 Nov 2026)
desc: v2 re-baseline 11 Nov 2026: G1 moved 10 Nov -> 24 Nov 2026 (G1 not approval-ready on target date; no build work had started before 10 Nov). G2 +14 days (7 Dec 2026); G3 onwards +28 days to absorb the slip plus the Dec/Jan holiday window (G3 8 Jan 2027, G4 8 Feb 2027, G5 9 Mar 2027) - PROPOSED, pending Project Owner approval. Milestones highlighted red. Supersedes v1 (26 Oct 2026, kept unchanged). AI accelerates scaffolding, tests, fixtures and documentation; security, architecture and accessibility require accountable human review.

tasks.name: H01 Product direction, audience and aerospace theme approved
tasks.notes: FlightDeck, Cockpit and aerospace design direction approved in project conversation.

tasks.name: H02 System Architecture v1.0 prepared
tasks.notes: Modular monolith, web-first, PostgreSQL/RLS, provider-neutral adapters and future mobile contracts documented.

tasks.name: H03 Technology, commercial and budget recommendations approved
tasks.notes: A01-A14 approved. Amendment: Excel and Mathematics first, SQL second; Excel simulator accelerated.

tasks.name: G0 Architecture and commercial approvals complete
tasks.notes: Historical approval gate complete. Hosting remains conditionally approved subject to compatibility spike.

tasks.name: FD-S01 Threat model, privacy map and RLS control matrix
tasks.notes: Threat model v0.1 (STRIDE, TB1-TB7, CT1-CT8), OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 L2 control map, privacy map (Kenya DPA 2019), role/capability matrix (RBAC) and grants + RLS matrix committed (repo docs/security). RLS-T01..T24 pass; mutation check 8/8 regressions caught. Remaining: Security Architect review; verify app_definer + auth schema grants on a Supabase staging project; ADR-002 decision; retention periods.

tasks.name: FD-D01 ERD, migrations, seeds and RLS policies
tasks.notes: Physical ERD (Mermaid, generated from schema), data dictionary (27 tables / 182 columns), baseline migration, grants + RLS migration (32 policies, column-level grants, SECURITY DEFINER helpers owned by NOLOGIN app_definer, search_path empty), server-only invoker functions (publish, simulator verdict). Evidence: packages/database, docs/data. Remaining: seeds for G2 catalogue; Data Architect review; apply to Supabase staging.

tasks.name: FD-U01 Design tokens, Cockpit and lesson-shell prototype
tasks.notes: Design tokens (light/dark) with WCAG 2.2 AA contrast gate (70 pairs; min text 5.09:1, min UI 3.75:1); Cockpit and lesson-shell prototype (Next.js 16.4 App Router) with skip link, landmarks, keyboard step rail, loading/error states. Playwright + axe E2E 30/30, 0 violations (light + dark). Remaining: human screen-reader pass, 320px/400% reflow, forced-colors check.

tasks.name: FD-Q01 Monorepo, CI, Playwright and architecture checks
tasks.notes: pnpm 10 + Turborepo monorepo on GitHub (Wachira-GK/flightdeck, main 1fd3095); pnpm check = secret/bundle scan + lint + typecheck + unit/RLS tests + build, all passing locally; RLS-T01..T24 28/28; mutation check 8/8; E2E 30/30. CI clean-run evidence: GitHub Actions quality run #4 (0dc0f36) green, actions upgraded to checkout v7 / setup-node v7 / pnpm action-setup v6. Remaining: human review.

tasks.name: FD-O01 Cloudflare compatibility spike and preview deployment
tasks.notes: Cloudflare compatibility spike PASSED 11 Nov on Godfrey Cloudflare Free account (flightdeck-web.godmarklee.workers.dev): OpenNext build, deploy (startup 17 ms, gzip 1,053 KiB), SSR + route handler + assets live, wrangler tail logs, rollback drill OK. CPU time 6-11 ms per SSR request = at the Free 10 ms cap -> production on Workers Paid (G0-approved). Remaining: ADR-003 decision (human); CSP/HSTS headers in G2. 26 Nov (from build log, percent is an estimate): Cloudflare Workers Paid active; production addresses flightdeck.stegmon.com and codeverse.stegmon.com live; Sim Bay served under /simbay; weekly backup and keep-alive in place.

tasks.name: FD-DOM01 Domain stegmon.com registered; subdomain plan decided
tasks.notes: Registered on Cloudflare Registrar (1 year, USD 11.17 at checkout). Brand decision closed: go live with stegmon.com; if the brand changes later, buy a new domain and transition. Subdomains per product: flightdeck.stegmon.com, codeverse.stegmon.com; Sim Bay stays under /simbay.

tasks.name: FD-DOM02 Subdomains live; code, configs and docs switched off workers.dev
tasks.notes: flightdeck.stegmon.com and codeverse.stegmon.com attached as custom domains (health check db ok). Sim Bay redirect, embed origins and CSP point at flightdeck.stegmon.com; keep-alive check, README and deploy notes updated; repos committed (FlightDeck and Sim Bay pushed). The old workers.dev addresses stay on as a fallback until FD-DOM07. Dated historical records (Gate status files, spike record) keep their original addresses on purpose.

tasks.name: FD-DOM03 Supabase Site URL and Redirect URLs for flightdeck.stegmon.com
tasks.notes: Godfrey, Supabase dashboard (Authentication, URL Configuration): set Site URL to https://flightdeck.stegmon.com and add https://flightdeck.stegmon.com/** to Redirect URLs (keep the old entry during the fallback period). Then test sign-in, password reset (?rid= link) and 2-step on the new address.

tasks.name: FD-DOM04 Google sign-in on stegmon.com
tasks.notes: Godfrey, Google Cloud (Branding): homepage https://flightdeck.stegmon.com, privacy /privacy, terms /terms, authorised domain stegmon.com; the Supabase callback URI does not change. Test Continue with Google on the new address.

tasks.name: FD-DOM05 Email on stegmon.com (Resend and Brevo, Supabase custom SMTP)
tasks.notes: Verify stegmon.com (sending subdomain such as mail.stegmon.com) on Resend and Brevo, with the DNS records added in Cloudflare; one active in Supabase custom SMTP, the other on standby; branded confirm and reset emails; lifts the default email rate limit. Pricing and limits of both services still to be checked on their official pages. Any paid step needs GREEN.

tasks.name: FD-DOM06 stegmon.com landing page and www redirect
tasks.notes: Simple landing page at stegmon.com linking to FlightDeck and CodeVerse; www redirects to the root. Content and wording to be agreed with Godfrey.

tasks.name: FD-DOM07 Retire the workers.dev fallback addresses
tasks.notes: Decision after about two stable weeks on stegmon.com: switch off workers.dev for flightdeck-web, excel-sim and codeverse, remove old Redirect URLs in Supabase and old entries in Google. Also decide HSTS preload only after the domain has been stable for a while.

tasks.name: FD-G1R Gate-1 evidence review (accountable human review)
tasks.notes: Review every P0 against the G1 approval rule: all P0 evidence, no untreated Critical/High risk, RLS-T01..T24 pass, clean CI, Cloudflare spike pass OR Vercel fallback ADR, keyboard/contrast review, no P0 waiver. Decision: Approve | Approve-with-P1-conditions | Reject. Checklist: docs/architecture/G1-STATUS.md.

tasks.name: G1 Architecture foundation accepted
tasks.notes: Re-baselined from 10 Nov 2026 (v1). Review threat model, ERD/RLS, design system, CI and hosting spike evidence.

tasks.name: FD-B01 Authentication, roles and Cockpit shell
tasks.notes: 13 Nov: sign-in/sign-up/sign-out built on Supabase Auth (ADR-007): HttpOnly cookie session, silent refresh, protected Cockpit with own name/roles via RLS, live test passed. Remaining: email-confirmation template + Site URL (Godfrey, Supabase dashboard), password reset, role-gated author/reviewer screens, MFA for staff roles, enrolment + progress persistence. 26 Nov (from build log, percent is an estimate): Email/password + Google sign-in, password reset, authenticator-app 2-step (admins required), user admin, roles with author/reviewer separation, mission access and enrolment are live. Remaining: custom-domain redirect URLs in Supabase/Google and branded email (see FD-DOM03..05).

tasks.name: FD-C01 Versioned Excel/Math catalogue and lesson blocks
tasks.notes: 12 Nov: seed generator content->catalogue.sql (3 tracks, 2 courses, 4 missions, 20 steps, keys only in app_private), 15 seed tests with drift check, static /catalogue page live. APPLIED to Supabase 12 Nov: author/reviewer roles granted to the two seed accounts, catalogue.sql loaded (tracks 3, courses 2, versions 2, missions 4, steps 20, exercises 5, assessments 4, items 16, keys 5+16), live checks all pass (anon sees published catalogue only, keys unreadable by anon/learner, seed idempotent). Remaining: missions.code/estimated_minutes migration; web catalogue reading from Supabase. 26 Nov (from build log, percent is an estimate): Excel missions live as database revisions (draft, review, publish, pinned per learner), levels Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced, author and reviewer screens. Remaining: Math missions are not authorable yet.

tasks.name: FD-XLS01 Excel simulator technical spike and formula engine
tasks.notes: Built 11 Nov (commit 635b6b3): own lexer/parser/evaluator (SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, IF allow-list; no eval), dependency graph with incremental recalculation and cycle detection, limits 100x30 / 500 cells / AST depth 30 / 5000 edges, deterministic server-side validateSubmission with hidden tests; 221 tests; 500-cell recalc 10-30 ms. Accessible ExcelGrid in a Web Worker with 500 ms watchdog. 3 exercises with separate answer keys. Open decisions: XLOOKUP in v1; formula library (custom recommended). Remaining: human review; server grading endpoint needs Supabase. 12 Nov: ADR-004 accepted; XLOOKUP exact-match added (270 tests); server check API; missions EX-101/102/103.

tasks.name: FD-MATH01 Mathematics renderer and interactive visual component
tasks.notes: Built 11 Nov (commit 635b6b3): packages/math statistics + numeric grader with worked steps (134 tests); KaTeX renderer (trust off, size limits); StatsExplorer (slider, data-table alternative, live region), NumericQuestion; MA-101 descriptive-statistics mission. Remaining: screen-reader review of MathML; teaching choices sign-off. 12 Nov: ADR-005 accepted; MA-101 assessment graded server-side (solutions only on pass).

tasks.notes: Test sign-in, role isolation, catalogue, Excel grid/formulas and Math visual on preview environment.

tasks.notes: AI generates state-machine tests and edge cases; deterministic server rules remain authoritative. 26 Nov (from build log, percent is an estimate): Enrolment button per course, Guest/Learner badges, saved progress and Cockpit are live. Remaining: resume and prerequisites.

Remaining: Sim Bay scores in exams/Cockpit.
